fields.description: Palace Residences brings one- to three-bedroom homes to Al Mamsha, with two towers linked by a landscaped podium. Courtyards, shaded routes and sky terraces connect private homes with spaces for swimming, exercise and meeting neighbours.

overview: Alef developed this Palace-branded collection in collaboration with Emaar Hospitality Group. The official community page lists 247 apartments across two buildings.
research.locationNote: Within Al Mamsha in Sharjah, off Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and near University City. No journey time is a traffic guarantee.
